posts.hook: Anthropic is turning its models on the bugs in power grids and open source
posts.caption: anthropic launched a cyber mission with a critical-infrastructure defense program and a free open-source scanner whose reports ship without human review, spacex bought spectrum to become a us mobile carrier, microsoft was suspended from a green card program. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Anthropic launches a Cyber Mission for infrastructure and open-source defense
slides.desc: Claude models and engineers go to 11 security partners protecting grids and water systems.

slides.title: OSS Scanner gives open-source projects free scans with no human review
slides.desc: Anthropic expects a true-positive rate above 90%, so maintainers still sort the reports.

terms.gloss: open-source software, code anyone can read and reuse

slides.title: SpaceX buys low-band spectrum to make Starlink a major US carrier
slides.desc: AT&T, T-Mobile and Verizon fell 6%+ after hours, pending FCC sign-off.

terms.gloss: the us regulator for radio and telecom

slides.title: Microsoft is suspended from a green card program and denies Vance's claim
slides.desc: It says most H-1B applications were for existing employees.

terms.gloss: the us work visa for skilled foreign employees

slides.title: GitHub's new classifier scores candidate secrets in under 2 ms
slides.desc: It could roughly double the leaked credentials blocked before they reach repository history.

posts.hook: Mistral wants the open-model crown, and OpenAI's fired researchers are fighting back
posts.caption: openai defended firing three safety researchers over how they handled sensitive information, mistral previewed a 1t-parameter model with open weights due october 27, deno is joining cloudflare. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: OpenAI says the three fired safety researchers broke sensitive-information policies
slides.desc: It calls it a breach of trust, not retaliation. The researchers dispute the misconduct claims.

slides.title: Mistral previews Large 4, a 1T-parameter model it says tops any US or European open model
slides.desc: The benchmark claim is Mistral's own until the weights arrive on October 27.

slides.title: Deno is joining Cloudflare
slides.desc: The team will work on making Workers and Durable Objects easier to self-host.

terms.gloss: a javascript and typescript runtime, a rival to node.js

slides.title: Meta launched Muse despite safety concerns after rival Instinct took off
slides.desc: The NYT says Zuckerberg decided to ship once a similar agent gained traction.

slides.title: A cryptographer puts 15% odds on losing confidence in public-key encryption to AI
slides.desc: AI surprises arrive faster than standards can be replaced, so preparation has to come first.

slides.title: Global PC shipments fell 20.1% in Q3, with higher prices and supply problems to blame
slides.desc: Apple is also asking suppliers to cut iPhone 18 Pro component output.
